summary: No record changes this turn: the run state is already complete and internally consistent — the parent question carries the violated/asserted account over eight receipts with the four witnessed consequence classes (per-replica accepted-index inflation and the lost reconfiguration endpoint and decided-log read, the one-index-per-round drift, the leader's decision at a drifted index on a write quorum of drifted reports, and both compaction paths acting on the drifted values), the two-orderings child is refuted, the trim and snapshot compaction children are violated/asserted, the trim and snapshot bound behaviours now cite their executed instances, and the two registered gaps name the next executable probes (the parent's drift-bound question after many more rounds and further leader changes, and the trim child's storage-route question about requesting a prefix below an over-compacted index). The next action is to extend the existing harness cases for the repeated rounds and the leader change into that drift-bound probe, sampling the reported accepted and decided indices and the readable decided log; the snapshot child's three named variants (equal-index request, direct follower call, forwarded peers) and the storage-route probe remain alongside it, with timers and loss-triggered re-synchronization, larger clusters, and persistence across restarts still unexercised.
